html:
Let’s explore the beauty of the landscape on a luxury cruise with majestic natural scenery, with limestone mountains gliding across the sea, and let’s take a look at the tourist attractions of Cat Ba on a cruise.

The cruise is surrounded by limestone ranges, mysterious caves, and in the distance are fishing villages hidden behind rows of casuarinas, exuding a magical beauty.

Swimming and kayaking: Visitors will row through famous landscapes, on the blue water creating a poetic picture.

Lan Ha Bay: When coming here, visitors should visit the mysterious caves surrounded by steep cliffs, visitors should visit famous caves such as: Dark Cave and Bright Cave… visitors should experience going deep inside to feel the beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place.

Fishing and visiting fishing villages: Visitors will learn about the lives of the people here, especially when dawn comes, the boats follow each other to go out to sea, when dusk comes, the boats have docked with boats full of fish and shrimp, with warm smiles…

Lan Ha Bay: Coming here, visitors will feel the pristine beauty with a long stretch of blue and white sand beach, when coming here, visitors should visit Monkey Island. Van Boi Beach is one of the beautiful destinations.

Rock climbing: If visitors are adventure lovers, experience rock climbing in Lan Ha Bay, from above visitors can admire the immense beauty of the sea and islands.

However, the most beautiful thing when traveling to Lan Ha Bay is watching the sunset falling on the sea, creating a poetic picture of the sea and islands.

So if you have the opportunity to travel to Cat Ba, visitors should experience a 5-star cruise on Lan Ha Bay, to experience and visit the most interesting things on the island.
